title: Identifiability-aware sparse inverse reaction inference for groundwater hydrogeochemistry: a PHREEQC benchmark and Northern Ghana transfer audit
scope: Controlled synthetic capability benchmark plus a non-validating chemistry-only field transfer audit.
objectives: Quantify exact-phase and equivalence-class recovery under controlled ground truth.
Test held-out-ion falsification and retrospective measurement prioritisation.
Demonstrate bounded transfer to Northern Ghana field chemistry without claiming field validation.
